title: Qualify and advertise equal-material fluid–fluid
requires: Each driver that will advertise this mode
scope: Run public-API lifecycle and physical cases before enabling the exact supported mode.
acceptance: Split/combined, stability, momentum, failure/recovery and three-family cases pass on each advertising driver.
Per-mode capability reporting and evidence list unsupported adapters/materials.
evidence: PASS: Linux RTX 3050 Ti CUDA produced 18/18 passing public-API equal-fluid quality samples across two fixtures, three timesteps, and three mass ratios.
PASS: CUDA resource, interaction-graph, and fluid-pair lifecycle tests passed 3/3, including replacement/recovery and three-family rollback coverage.
PASS: capability qualification evaluates CONTACT, PRESSURE, and VISCOSITY at 3/3 qualified with zero failures; source, binary, device, toolchain, contracts, and artifacts are hash-pinned.
BOUNDARY: Vulkan fluid-pair lifecycle and quality tests both report unsupported; miscible, immiscible-interface, and thermal-phase records remain unadvertised.
